name: select
title: Select
description: One choice from a list, on Base UI's Select: a trigger that looks like an Input and shows the chosen label, and a listbox popup with items, groups and separators, in three sizes.

manifest.name: select
manifest.title: Select
manifest.description: One choice from a list, on Base UI's Select: a trigger that looks like an Input and shows the chosen label, and a listbox popup with items, groups and separators, in three sizes.
manifest.usage: Use Select when the user picks one value from a fixed list of about five to thirty options they need not type (SSL mode, engine, isolation level). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items (a record of value to label, or { value, label } objects) so the trigger shows the label before the popup opens, and list the options as SelectItem children, grouped with SelectGroup and SelectGroupLabel when that helps. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field; null means nothing is chosen. For two to six options that should all be visible use RadioGroup; for long or searchable lists, Combobox; for several values, MultiSelect.

props.name: items
props.description: Value-to-label data for the trigger; the options themselves are the children.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled chosen value; null when nothing is chosen.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user chooses an option.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the trigger, in color.fg.subtle, while nothing is chosen.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the popup; defaultOpen and onOpenChange as in Base UI.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the hidden input; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: An option must be chosen before the form submits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction; a Field's disabled sets it too.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable but the popup does not open.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no FieldLabel.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the trigger, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: role="combobox" with aria-haspopup="listbox"; data-slot="select", data-size and data-popup-open name it. A hidden <input> follows it for forms.

slots.name: value
slots.description: The chosen label, or the placeholder with data-placeholder; data-slot="select-value".

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal at the end of <body>, at z.dropdown, with the trigger's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="select-positioner".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: The surface, color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay; at least the trigger's width and at most the height left in the viewport; data-slot="select-popup".

parts.name: SelectItem
parts.description: One option, role="option": its text, and a check mark while chosen; color.interactive.hover while highlighted.

parts.name: SelectGroup
parts.description: A group of options, role="group", named by its SelectGroupLabel.

parts.name: SelectGroupLabel
parts.description: A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: SelectSeparator
parts.description: A 1 px line in color.border.default between options or groups.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the trigger: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: open
states.description: While the popup is open the trigger border is color.border.focus.

states.name: entering
states.description: The popup fades in over motion.duration.fast with motion.easing.enter, and out with motion.easing.exit (data-ending-style).

states.name: placeholder
states.description: Nothing chosen: the placeholder in color.fg.subtle.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The option under the pointer or the keyboard: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field, or with aria-invalid: color.status.danger.border borders.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction, at opacity.disabled; a disabled option is color.fg.disabled.

accessibility: The trigger is a <button role="combobox"> with aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected.

Enter, Space, ArrowDown and ArrowUp open the popup; arrow keys, Home and End move the highlight, typing jumps to the option that starts with the text, Enter chooses and Escape closes, and focus returns to the trigger.
Disabled options are skipped by the keyboard and shown in color.fg.disabled; a group's label names the group (aria-labelledby).
The chosen option shows a check mark as well as its place in the trigger, so the state does not rest on colour; the trigger border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface).
The popup takes the trigger's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>, so its contrast matches the page it opened from.
